name: 夕阳三-炎龙美化版
english_name: Sunset Reappears III: Seal of the Fire Dragon (Fire Dragon Edition)
english_description: Sunset Reappears III: Seal of the Fire Dragon, produced by AKAI Studio, uses the old Tomud/"Laughing in the Wind" client handshake protocol, where the first line after connecting must be answered with the literal code 2060. Despite its "Sunset Reappears" branding, its map data is byte-for-byte identical to the unrelated "Tianya" (Edge of Heaven) family of games rather than to the true Sunset Reappears lineage, one of several archives in this collection where the title brand and the actual code lineage don't match.
